fields.System.Title: INV-704 — Warn when adjusting reserved stock
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want to be told when an adjustment affects stock promised to
orders, so that the picker does not discover the problem at an empty shelf.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a downward adjustment on stock with reservations, then the affected orders are
  • listed before the adjustment is applied.
  • - Given the adjustment proceeds, then inventory.stock_adjusted is published carrying
  • the affected reservations.
  • - Given that event, then outbound re-checks and re-allocates the affected lines.
  • - Given a line that cannot be re-allocated, then it is flagged for a supervisor rather
  • than left silently short.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory, outbound |
| Tables | stock_balance, reservation, outbox |
| Risks | Adjustment silently invalidating an allocation ([doc 09 §4.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration · event assertion |
